'''Ivis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Private/Legends|private]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Affiliated with the [[House of Thul]] and wearing their uniform, he sold various items near the [[Thul Palace]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].
